lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's thirty-three? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 33? Nope!

lines.text: One, three, six, ten, fifteen: each step adds one more.
lines.caption: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15: each step adds one more.

lines.text: How many of the first one hundred numbers are multiples of three?
lines.caption: How many of the first 100 numbers are multiples of 3?

lines.text: Track the remainder after dividing by three: one, zero, zero, and repeat.
lines.caption: Track the remainder after dividing by 3: 1, 0, 0, and repeat.

lines.text: So every group of three spots holds two multiples!
lines.caption: So every group of 3 spots holds 2 multiples!

lines.text: One hundred spots is thirty-three groups, plus one extra spot, which leaves one.
lines.caption: 100 spots is 33 groups, plus 1 extra spot, which leaves 1.

lines.text: Thirty-three groups, times two each. That's sixty-six!
lines.caption: 33 groups, times 2 each. That's 66!

lines.text: Thirty-three was the trap. Spots two, five and eight count too!
lines.caption: 33 was the trap. Spots 2, 5 and 8 count too!

lines.text: Did you get sixty-six? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 66? Tell me below!
